caption: The drawing depicts a person standing in profile, facing left. The figure is dressed in a red tunic with yellow trim at the sleeves, hem, and waist, cinched with a yellow belt. The figure wears green knee-length pants and yellow leggings that cover the lower legs and feet, with the toes exposed. The person has medium skin tone and long black hair, and is adorned with a headdress that features three upward-pointing feathers colored in light blue, brown, and blue, along with a light-colored headband at the base. The person holds a small object resembling a bundle or group of thin, dark-colored sticks or rods in their right hand, which is extended forward. The background is plain and uncolored, providing no additional objects or scenery.
title: Cigar Store Indian
